fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (failed URLs are not written to the dataset -- they are reported in the ERRORS record of the run's key-value store). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld) carry headline/articleBody-style fields extracted from the NewsArticle ld+json node. Latest-mode records (S2-rss, from the Google Publisher feed) carry title/link-style fields, including the full article HTML body in contentHtml.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (article URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld for articles, S2-rss for latest headlines, or 'none' on error).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline (article mode; raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle).

description.title: Description
description.description: Short summary/dek. Present in article mode (NewsArticle.description) and latest mode (RSS <description>).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text (article mode; raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle.articleBody).

articleSection.title: Article section
articleSection.description: Section/category the article belongs to (article mode; e.g. Politics, Media).

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: Original publish date/time (article mode; raw passthrough from JSON-LD, ISO 8601 string).

dateModified.title: Date modified
dateModified.description: Last-modified date/time (article mode; raw passthrough from JSON-LD, ISO 8601 string).

author.title: Author
author.description: Article author's display name (article mode; extracted from JSON-LD NewsArticle.author.name).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keywords/tags associated with the article (article mode; raw passthrough from JSON-LD, shape may vary -- string or array).

wordCount.title: Word count
wordCount.description: Article word count as reported by the CMS (article mode; raw passthrough from JSON-LD).

isAccessibleForFree.title: Is accessible for free
isAccessibleForFree.description: Whether the article is free to read (article mode; raw passthrough boolean from JSON-LD NewsArticle).

image.title: Image URL
image.description: Lead/hero image URL for the article (article mode; extracted from JSON-LD NewsArticle.image, which may be an object or a list of objects).

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline of the latest-mode item (from RSS <title>).

link.title: Link
link.description: Canonical article URL for the latest-mode item (from RSS <link>).

guid.title: GUID
guid.description: Feed-provided globally unique identifier for the latest-mode item (from RSS <guid>).

pubDate.title: Publish date
pubDate.description: Publish date/time of the latest-mode item as a raw RSS date string (from RSS <pubDate>).

contentHtml.title: Content HTML
contentHtml.description: Full article body HTML inlined by the feed (latest mode; from RSS <content:encoded>, HTML-entity-escaped in the source).

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: List of category/taxonomy labels for the latest-mode item (from RSS <category> tags; mixes internal taxonomy IDs with human-readable labels).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
